AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM – TROUBLESHOOTING

PANEL DIAGNOSIS SYSTEM

If a trouble occurs in A/C system, the specified lamp on the control panel starts blinking during the diagnostic sensor check.
During system diagnosis, a trouble is indicated on the panel by the blinking of a specified light instead of a code display. (See TROUBLE CODE CHART)
For example, when a trouble occurs in solar sensor circuit, the LED for DEF mode switch will be blinking during the diagnostic sensor check.
